verdict.rationale: PlanetScale's only self-hosting-related capability in the evidence is a single mention of 'bring your own cloud with PlanetScale Managed', which runs the product in the customer's own cloud account but is still vendor-operated. A community user reports the product cannot be installed locally, run offline, or obtained as open source, which limits this to BYOC rather than true self-hosting. Missing for 10: a documented self-managed or on-prem install of the core product, offline or local operation, open-source availability, and in-depth docs on what PlanetScale Managed deployment involves.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
